items.summary: Implement a single global ThemeProvider/ThemeContext that stores `theme` ('light'|'dark'|'system') and `effectiveTheme` ('light'|'dark'), and centralizes all DOM theme class application (adding/removing `light`/`dark` on `document.documentElement`) in exactly one place.

Refactor the existing theme hook API so app code can continue using a hook to access theme state, but ensure there are no DOM reads during render and no duplicate system-theme listeners; only one system preference listener is active and only when `theme === 'system'`.
Update ThemeToggle to use the ThemeContext values for rendering (including aria-label and icon state) and for toggling, eliminating icon/state desynchronization.
Ensure localStorage persistence for theme preference only happens in the explicit theme setter/toggle action (not on every render and not in effects that run repeatedly).

Make the Home → Ritual History entry dialog readable by ensuring the dialog content surface is fully opaque (optionally with a subtle backdrop blur) in both light and dark themes, without editing any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose via className overrides at the call site).
